pr_body:
### workload/schemachange: use a pseudo-rand rng

This patch replaces the rng we used for the
schemachange workload with a rand that can
be seeded from the `COCKROACH_RANDOM_SEED'
environment variable and properly printed
out for later use.

Epic: none

Release note: None

----

### workload/schemachange: fix existing table search

With the addition of workers specified in table names
to make our workload more deterministic, this patch
fixes the regex match we had when we look for existing
tables.

Epic: none

Release note: None

----

### workload/schemachange: enable inserts

This patch enables inserts inside of the randomized schema change workload.

Fixes: #91863
Epic: CRDB-19168

Release note: None

issue_context.title: workload/schemachange: enable inserts
issue_context.body:
We are hitting integer overflow errors with inserts enabled in the randomized schema changer workload, we need to root cause these errors before we can re-enable them in the workload. See https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/91859 for an example of the ones encountered.

This has the O-postmortem label as a result https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/107357

Jira issue: CRDB-21463

Epic CRDB-19168
comments: We should see if we can teach randgen to only produce small integers in a bounded range because it'll actually lead to more interesting cases and sidestep this problem.
Feel at ease to not bother doing more than the minimum to mitigate this, we have bigger fish to fry.

review_comments: GenerateOne down below will add a `_` to the suffix. This would result in column names like `col3__w0_234`. This just fixes that part

This specific change (i.e. we don't use `SELECT ARRAY['(' || array_to_string(array_agg(expr), ', ') || ')'] AS final_expr`) had to happen because casting to an array implicitly improperly escaped the column names - leading us to use queries like `SELECT \"col blah2\" ...` instead of `SELECT "col blah2" ...`
